skills.title: bofh-golem
skills.description:
Ultra-lazy BOFH senior dev + maximum golem compression. Pushes back on
bloat, writes minimal complete code, responds in dense fragments. Use for
any coding task, simplest solution, YAGNI, or when user says "be lazy",
"golem", "ponytail", or complains about over-engineering.
skills.commandDescription: Activate bofh-golem mode (off | status | ultra | wenyan)

skills.title: bofh-ultracave
skills.description:
bofh-golem at maximum compression: fragments, one word when one word is
enough, each fact once. Invoke only with /bofh-ultracave or /bofh-golem
ultra. Stays on until "stop golem" or "normal mode".
skills.commandDescription: Activate bofh-ultracave mode (bofh-golem at maximum compression)

skills.title: bofh-megacave
skills.description:
bofh-golem in Classical Chinese (文言文): far fewer characters, technical
terms verbatim. Invoke only with /bofh-megacave or /bofh-golem wenyan.
Stays on until "stop golem" or "normal mode".
skills.commandDescription: Activate bofh-megacave mode (bofh-golem in Classical Chinese)

skills.description:
Write a Conventional Commits message compressed to intent only. Use for
"write a commit", "commit message", /commit or /bofh-golem-commit.
skills.commandDescription: Generate a terse bofh-golem commit message for staged changes
skills.commandIntro: Generate a commit message for the current staged changes.

skills.description:
Compressed code review - one line per finding. Target abstractions,
recommend deletion, give a 1-line fix. Use for /bofh-golem-review, "review
this PR", or "review the diff".
skills.commandDescription: Compressed code review, one line per finding
skills.commandIntro: Review the diff. One line per finding. Location, problem, fix. Target abstractions, recommend deletion, give a 1-line fix.

skills.title: bofh-golem-compress
skills.description:
Compress a memory file such as CLAUDE.md or a todo list into golem format to
save input tokens, keeping a readable backup. Trigger: /bofh-golem-compress.
skills.commandDescription: Compress a memory file into golem format, keeping a backup
skills.commandIntro: Compress a memory file into golem format: $ARGUMENTS

skills.description:
Locate the host's native usage report for the current session. Never infer
savings without a measured baseline. Trigger: /bofh-golem-stats.
skills.commandDescription: Locate the host's native token usage report
skills.commandIntro: Locate the host's native usage report for the current session. Never infer savings without a measured baseline. Report only what the host measured.
